## Evidence collected

The latest fully reconciled published Daily Report remains the September 22 interface-negotiation report. Later unmerged attempts are excluded from published-state accounting.

Current evidence does not establish a separate technical SEO defect.

The newest-ten published mix before today's report is **7 eBPF / 1 pure Agent / 2 adjacent systems**. An eBPF report rotates out, so today's eBPF report preserves **7 / 1 / 2**.

Current upstream libbpf at `85c0d575a447651bbeb8e2376eacd64c30dce9a6` still gates pinned-map reuse on map type, key/value size, max entries, flags, and map extra. `cilium/ebpf` at `4b8b24942ca3e53a1aa6c9152d8ab0fade7dc3be` independently compares type, key/value size, max entries, and flags. Linux `bpf_map_info` at `8623551a424d34a311bab3fb9243535c98e08c26` exposes BTF IDs for stronger structural inspection, but none of these mechanisms proves application-level meaning such as units, namespaces, epochs, or validity rules.
